title: ECHS Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 03 Dental Officer, Dental Technical/ Assistant/ Hygienist and Lab Technician Posts
description: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) has issued the official notification for the recruitment of 03 Dental Officers, Dental Technical/ Assistant/ Hygienist, and Lab Technician Jobs. Candidates who have qualified for BDS or B.Sc. can grab this chance and apply for the ECHS Notification 2026.
